summary: Sandbach United fell to a 3-2 defeat against Foley Meir in a frustrating encounter where they created several clear-cut chances but couldn't find the back of the net when it mattered. Saul Shotton's late volley gave the Bach hope, but it proved to be too little too late as their opponents' keeper made some crucial saves to seal the win. The side will look to bounce back when they face Stafford Town on Saturday.
